newsitem.title: UK: United News retains London free newspaper.
newsitem.headline: United News retains London free newspaper.

text.p: United News and Media Plc said on Tuesday it planned to retain the London-based free newspapers, which it had been expected to sell.

The group said in a statement on a divisional reorganisation that it had "received a number of approaches from third parties about these titles. Although offering attractive prices they did not reflect the significant improvement in trading prospects, leading to them being rebuffed."
Under the reorganisation, the group also said it planned to move two businesses in its regional newspaper unit to the United Advertising Publications unit.
The businesses which will be tranferred are the portfolio of Spanish titles and the free newspapers in London including the Yellow Advertiser and Informer series.
United said the move would create a more integrated management structure and enable the regional paper unit to develop its activities in the north of England.
The UAP unit's leading publication, Exchange & Mart, will additionally have its cover price halved to 60 pence.
The price change will be implemented across most of the UK. In trial runs the move led to a 50 percent hike in circulation and record levels of advertising revenues.
